name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
description: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 1,000 to eligible women heads of families in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_criteria: Woman head of family (major earner or sole earner)
Age 21 or above
Annual family income below Rs 2.5 lakh
Resident of Tamil Nadu with valid ration card
application_steps: Apply online at magalir.tn.gov.in or at nearest Ration Shop / VAO office
Submit documents and verify mobile number
Application verified by Village Administrative Officer
Funds credited monthly to bank account

name: CM Breakfast Scheme (TN)
full_name: Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme – Tamil Nadu
description: Free nutritious breakfast to government primary school students in Tamil Nadu.
benefit: Free breakfast (nutritious hot meal) every school day.
eligibility_criteria: Student of government primary school (Classes I–V) in Tamil Nadu
application_steps: No separate application; automatically covered on enrollment in government primary school
Breakfast served at school

name: Thamizha Thandai Thittam
full_name: Thamizha Thandai Thittam – Tamil Nadu (Senior Citizen Housing)
description: Old-age pension and housing support scheme for destitute senior citizens in Tamil Nadu.
benefit: Rs 1,000/month pension + priority for government housing.
eligibility_criteria: Age 60 or above
Tamil Nadu resident
Annual income below Rs 1.2 lakh
No other pension from government
application_steps: Apply at District Social Welfare Office or nearest Ration Shop
Submit age and income proof
Verified by Revenue Department
Pension credited monthly

name: CM Green Farms Scheme (TN)
full_name: Chief Minister's Green Farms Scheme – Tamil Nadu
description: Subsidy for solar-powered pump sets to reduce electricity cost for Tamil Nadu farmers.
benefit: Up to 100% subsidy on solar pump sets (capacity up to 10 HP) for small and marginal farmers.
eligibility_criteria: Registered farmer in Tamil Nadu with agricultural land
Small or marginal farmer preferred
Must have power connection applied or approved for agriculture
application_steps: Apply through TANGEDCO district office or nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra
Submit land and farmer registration documents
Site inspection by TANGEDCO
Pump set installed; subsidy adjusted in bill

name: Ladki Bahin Yojana (MH)
full_name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana – Maharashtra
description: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 1,500 to eligible women in Maharashtra.
benefit: Rs 1,500/month to eligible women directly to bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Woman aged 21–65 years
Maharashtra resident with valid domicile certificate
Annual family income below Rs 2.5 lakh
Has a bank account
application_steps: Apply online at ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in or through nearest Seva Kendra
Fill application form and upload documents
Verification by Tehsil office
Monthly transfer to bank account

name: Ramai Awas Yojana (MH)
description: Housing scheme for SC/NB category families in Maharashtra.
benefit: Rs 1.2 lakh grant for construction of a pucca house.
eligibility_criteria: SC (Scheduled Caste) or Nav Bauddha (NB) category family
Annual income below Rs 1.2 lakh
Houseless or living in kutcha house
Maharashtra domicile
application_steps: Apply at District Social Welfare Office (DSWO)
Submit all documents
District-level verification and selection
Amount released in two installments based on construction progress

name: Shasan Aple Dari (MH)
full_name: Shasan Aple Dari – Maharashtra Government at Your Doorstep
description: Mobile camp that brings government services including certificates, pensions and scheme enrollments directly to villages.
benefit: On-the-spot issuance of income, caste, residence certificates; enrollment in pension and welfare schemes.
eligibility_criteria: Maharashtra resident
Scheduled camp visit to the village
documents: Existing proof documents relevant to the service requested
application_steps: Check camp schedule at aapledarbar.maharashtra.gov.in or local Gram Panchayat
Attend camp on scheduled day with documents
Submit request at relevant department counter
Certificate / enrollment issued same day where possible

name: Lakshmir Bhandar (WB)
description: Monthly income support to women heads of households in West Bengal.
eligibility_criteria: Woman head of household aged 25–60
West Bengal resident with valid ration card
Household member not employed in government sector
Has a bank account
application_steps: Apply through Duare Sarkar camps or online at lakshmibhandar.wb.gov.in
Submit documents and mobile number
Verified by local administration
Monthly transfer to bank account

name: Swasthya Sathi (WB)
description: Cashless health insurance of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for all West Bengal residents.
benefit: Rs 5 lakh/year cashless hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility_criteria: West Bengal resident
Annual family income below Rs 1.5 lakh
Enrolled through Duare Sarkar / Gram Panchayat
application_steps: Enroll at Duare Sarkar camp or nearest health department office
Submit documents
Smart card issued
Use card for cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals

name: Kanya Sumangala Yojana (UP)
full_name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana – Uttar Pradesh
description: Financial support to girl children in UP at six key life stages from birth to graduation.
benefit: Total Rs 15,000 in 6 installments: Rs 2,000 at birth, Rs 1,000 at vaccination, Rs 2,000 at Class I entry, Rs 2,000 at Class VI entry, Rs 3,000 at Class IX entry, Rs 5,000 at graduation/diploma entry.
eligibility_criteria: Girl child (resident of UP)
Annual family income below Rs 3 lakh
Maximum 2 girls per family
Institutional delivery preferred for birth installment
documents: Bank account in girl's name (or guardian)
application_steps: Apply online at mksy.up.gov.in or at nearest ICDS / CDO office
Register and create profile
Apply for relevant installment stage
Verification by District Probation Officer
Amount transferred to bank account

name: UP Old Age Pension
description: Monthly pension for BPL senior citizens in Uttar Pradesh.
benefit: Rs 500/month (including central share) credited to bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Age 60 or above
UP resident
Annual income below Rs 46,080 (rural) or Rs 56,460 (urban)
No other government pension
application_steps: Apply online at sspy-up.gov.in or at District Social Welfare Office
Fill form and upload documents
Gram Sabha / Ward verification
Pension credited quarterly

name: PMAY Urban (UP)
full_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) – Uttar Pradesh implementation
description: Housing subsidy under PMAY-U for EWS/LIG/MIG urban families in UP.
benefit: Interest subsidy of 3–6.5% on home loans (Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme); outright grant for EWS slum dwellers.
eligibility_criteria: Urban area resident of UP
EWS (income < Rs 3 lakh), LIG (Rs 3–6 lakh) or MIG (Rs 6–18 lakh)
No pucca house in any urban area of India for self or family member
Woman co-owner mandatory for EWS/LIG
application_steps: Apply at ULB (Urban Local Body) or online at pmaymis.gov.in
Select EWS/LIG/MIG-I/MIG-II category
Submit self-declaration and documents
List published by ULB; loan linked through PLI bank for CLSS

name: Raitha Siri (KA)
full_name: Raitha Siri – Karnataka Farmer Family Support
description: Annual income support to farmer families in Karnataka as addition to PM-KISAN.
benefit: Rs 4,000/year in addition to PM-KISAN (total Rs 10,000/year for eligible farmers).
eligibility_criteria: Farmer with land in Karnataka (up to 2 hectares)
Registered in e-RTC (Rights, Tenancy, Cultivation) records
Annual family income below Rs 2 lakh
application_steps: Register on Bhoomi or Raitha Siri portal (raithasiri.karnataka.gov.in)
Verify land and Aadhaar linkage
Application auto-populated from e-RTC
Amount credited in two installments

name: Gruha Jyothi (KA)
description: Free 200 units of electricity per month to domestic consumers in Karnataka.
benefit: Zero electricity bill for consumption up to 200 units/month; excess units billed normally.
eligibility_criteria: Domestic electricity connection in Karnataka (LT-1 tariff)
Single residential connection per household
Registered under HESCOM/BESCOM/MESCOM/GESCOM/CHESCOM
documents: Bank account (for subsidy credit if applicable)
application_steps: Automatically applied to eligible domestic meters
Check gejayojane.karnataka.gov.in to verify eligibility
If not applied, apply at nearest ESCOM consumer service centre

name: Anna Bhagya (KA)
full_name: Anna Bhagya – Karnataka Free Rice Scheme
description: Free 10 kg rice per person per month to ration card holders in Karnataka.
benefit: 10 kg rice per person per month free through ration shops.
eligibility_criteria: BPL/Antyodaya ration card holder in Karnataka
Annual family income below Rs 1.5 lakh
documents: Aadhaar card (for biometric authentication at shop)
application_steps: Collect rice at nearest Fair Price Shop (Ration Shop) using ration card
Biometric/Aadhaar authentication at POS machine
Entitlement: 10 kg per family member per month

name: Krishak Bandhu (WB)
full_name: Krishak Bandhu – West Bengal Farmer Income Support
description: Annual income support of Rs 10,000 per acre (max Rs 10,000/year for up to 1 acre) and Rs 2 lakh death benefit to farmers in West Bengal.
benefit: Rs 5,000 per acre per season (kharif + rabi = Rs 10,000/year for 1 acre); Rs 2 lakh accidental death insurance.
eligibility_criteria: Farmer with land records in West Bengal (minimum 0.01 acre)
Registered in Krishak Bandhu portal
For death benefit: family of farmer aged 18–60
application_steps: Register at krishakbandhu.net or nearest Krishi Bhavan
Submit land and identity documents
Verified by Block Agriculture Officer
Amount credited twice yearly; death benefit to nominee on claim

name: Dr Ambedkar Law Scholarship (TN)
full_name: Dr Ambedkar Law Scholarship – Tamil Nadu SC/ST Students
description: Full scholarship for SC/ST students pursuing law (LLB/LLM) in Tamil Nadu.
benefit: Full tuition fee + maintenance allowance (Rs 1,500/month hosteller, Rs 750/month day scholar).
eligibility_criteria: SC or ST student in Tamil Nadu
Enrolled in recognised law college (LLB/LLM)
Annual family income below Rs 2 lakh
Not receiving any other scholarship
application_steps: Apply at college scholarship coordinator or District Social Welfare Office
Submit documents within deadline
Forwarded by college to DPI/Social Welfare Department
Scholarship credited to bank account

name: MJPJAY (MH)
full_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana – Maharashtra
description: State health insurance of Rs 1.5 lakh per year for BPL and farmers in Maharashtra (combined with PM-JAY gives Rs 5 lakh).
benefit: Rs 1.5 lakh/year (up to Rs 5 lakh combined with PMJAY) cashless hospitalisation.
eligibility_criteria: Maharashtra resident
Annual family income below Rs 1 lakh (BPL), or farmer (Yellow/Orange ration card)
Any family member as beneficiary
documents: Yellow/Orange ration card or BPL certificate
application_steps: Visit empanelled hospital or nearest Arogya Mitra centre
Check eligibility by Aadhaar / ration card
Get MJPJAY card issued
Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals

name: Vidya Siri (KA)
description: Post-matric scholarship for SC/ST students in Karnataka for professional and non-professional courses.
benefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance (Rs 550–1,200/month depending on course and hostel/day).
eligibility_criteria: SC or ST student in Karnataka
Post-matric course (Class XI and above)
Annual family income below Rs 2.5 lakh
Karnataka domicile
application_steps: Apply online at sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in or scholarships.gov.in
Submit documents online and at institution
Institution forwards to DSWO
Amount credited to bank account
